The '''skirmish on Dxun''' were several small-scale skirmishes that took place on the [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. [[Meetra Surik]] and [[Gender/Legends|her]] allies crash-landed on the moon after [[Onderonian/Legends|Onderonian]] ships forced [[Ebon Hawk|their ship]] to land. The team allied with [[Canderous Ordo]] (now Mandalore the Preserver) and his [[Mandalorians (Clan Ordo)|Mandalorian clan]] and helped them defeat Onderonian [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] that [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tobin (Human)|Tobin]] sent to the planet to locate the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|Exile]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />

The Exile was also forced to deal with [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] that were sent after her and defeated them outside [[Mandalorian Outpost (Dxun)|the Mandalorian camp]]. The team planned to leave for [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] but were forced to do battle with [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] that infiltrated the camp to ambush them before Surik could depart with her companions for [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />

==Prelude==
The [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Meetra Surik]] traveled with [[Gender/Legends|her]] allies to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] to find the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kavar]] who was in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. But [[Blockade of Onderon|the blockade]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] proved an obstacle before [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tobin (Human)|Tobin]] dispatched his ships to attack [[Ebon Hawk|their ship]] that forced them to land on the [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to avoid destruction. Surik and her allies proceeded outside to explore the moon with the intention to still travel to Onderon for their mission.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

But the contract that the [[Exchange]] put out on Surik (and other Jedi who survived [[First Jedi Purge|the purge]]) was still in place and still made her vulnerable to some [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] attempting to locate her. This included the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunters]] under [[Dezanti Zhug]] who also traveled to Onderon to find her; their [[Zhug Ship|vessel]] was also shot and forced them to crash-land on the surface.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

==The skirmishes==
===Crash-landed hunters===
{{Quote|The Exchange has put a bounty on your head, human. A very profitable amount. My family has accepted the job.|Dezanti Zhug confronts Meetra Surik|<ref name="KOTOR2" />}}
[[File:Zhugship3-crop.png|thumb|right|250px|Dezanti Zhug and his people crash-land on Dxun to locate Meetra Surik.]]
Surik and her allies decided to leave the ship in order to explore the moon while [[Atton Rand]] set to repair the ship. But the Exile and her companions encountered Dezanti Zhug and his two Duros companions in a jungle clearing where their ship had crash-landed. Surik was unable to negotiate a peaceful solution to their predicament and were forced to engage and eliminate Zhug and his allies in the ensuing confrontation.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

===Scout forces===
{{Quote|We can't let them find the camp, if that's what they're looking for. We need to track them down and make sure their trip here is real short.|Kelborn requests Meetra Surik's assistance in hunting down the scouts|<ref name="KOTOR2" />}}
[[File:LaaneKelborn.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Kelborn]], upon finding [[Laane]] dead.]]
The Exile encountered several [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] who took them to their leader [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]]. The two formed a tentative alliance and Mandalore promised to take Surik to Onderon if he aided the [[Mandalorians (Clan Ordo)|Mandalorian clan]] with several errands that could test her. Surik proceeded to leave the camp where she encountered the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Kelborn]] who had just discovered a [[Laane|dead Onderonian scout]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />

Kelborn said that he tracked two ships that came onto the moon and said that the Onderonian scouts that came to the planet were silent while the Duros ship that crash-landed had its signature transmitting the entire descent. Kelborn explained that the scouts had to be [[Death/Legends|killed]] to ensure that the Mandalorian camp was kept secret lest the Onderonians send soldiers to attack them at the base. Surik decided to aid Kelborn and encountered two units further along the jungle paths. Surik discovered that Colonel Tobin sent the scouts to hunt her down while Kelborn explained that Tobin served [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]] which meant that Surik had a powerful foe in Iziz.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

===Sith ambush===
{{Quote|Mandalorians, we've got company! Stealthed targets have breached our perimeter!|Zuka alerts the camp to the Sith's presence|<ref name="KOTOR2" />}}
The tasks that Surik completed led for Mandalore to decide to take her to Onderon so that she could continue her mission. [[Kreia]] solicited Ordo's assistance further when she revealed what she knew about [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] whom Ordo once served in [[Jedi Civil War|the previous war]]. But just as Kreia left Ordo to ponder her words, several [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] ambushed the Mandalorians in the camp after having been cloaked throughout the base. Surik and Kreia joined their allies to help repel the invading force throughout the base.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

But Ordo decided to allow his people to finish dealing with the assassins while he and Surik would leave for Iziz at once.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Seems trouble follows you on a regular basis. I think it's best for both of us if we head to Iziz immediately. Grab your gear. My men will take care of cleaning up the mess.|Mandalore the Preserver suggests he and Surik leave for Iziz|<ref name="KOTOR2" />}}
The team arrived in Iziz where Mandalore put them in contact with the [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] (and his old friend) [[Dhagon Ghent]]. Their meeting in his office in the [[Merchant Quarter]] took place after Surik and Ordo had to help clear Ghent from murder charges against an [[Sullio|Onderonian officer]]. Ghent was able to arrange a meeting between Surik and Kavar but the meeting was short-lived with Tobin forcing them both to flee from [[Unidentified Iziz cantina|the cantina]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />
